name: San Bartolomé de la Torre (Spain)
description: Red field with a green triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of San Bartolomé de la Torre (a bend on white and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of San Bartolomé de la Torre; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
